Current status after2026-10-11 evening: step-dependent accumulated regularization fixes the observed fine-level optimization stall but does not establish an anatomically better HalfFlow recipe. Optional quadratic blend w=min(1,step/maxStep)^2 approaches the current state under backtracking. Default is false; full/zero smoothing arithmetic and admission gates are preserved.

Two predeclared three-sentinel recipes (total smoothing1.5/2.25mm at fine level, target40) all reach20coarse+20fine and pass native, independent geometry and full-cell gates, but each passes strict anatomy only2/3. OASIS11-12 loses paired Dice .009362/.018794 versus previousselected. Both recipes rejected; six-case remainder not run. A separately declared physical6mm CC-window probe also reaches40valid updates but fails anatomy, Dice -.013185/HD95 +.102080mm; expansion not run. All seven HalfFlow maps and failed gates retained. Previous selected recipe remains unchanged, with its fine-stage limitation. New fresh study was affine-only; no new HalfFlow confirmation claim.

Next work should investigate why accepted fine-level similarity improvements worsen anatomical registration, using these observed cases only for development. Preserve composed-map inverse and cell-topology admission. A new tuned recipe needs a newly frozen confirmation; all16MMRR subjects used so far are observed. Final source7165f52a68b9be7402e60832a9e3537e5c4d2eead735136b8ccbe91db56137bd. Evidence docs/benchmarks/evidence/real-mri-backtracking-20261011; report docs/benchmarks/real-image-development.md. Relevant HalfFlow engine/export/controller tests32JVM/32JS pass; runner22, Pythonhelpers7, ownership1489names/66owners pass.

Historical geometry context:

The predeclared 20/40/80-update real-MRI learning study is exposing an exportability limit rather than a simple lack of iterations. Frozen development source 5b2105a7c852d9b1eed3f60c9dc43285ace3908a0ba24fdebf607ae3070f03f9; protocol docs/benchmarks/evidence/real-mri-calibration-20261011/development-protocol.json. All first six longer fits fail unchanged checks. At 40 total updates: OASIS 11-to-12 native residual inverse max 0.3687 mm, independent brain roundtrip 0.2235 mm; 15-to-16 native inverse 0.9126 mm and reverse brain roundtrip 0.338 mm; 1-to-10 improves forward Dice to 0.441 but brain roundtrip reaches 0.389 mm. At 80 updates, 1-to-10 fails the shrink-1 transition with fixed accumulated minimum Jacobian 0.00745; 11-to-12 and 15-to-16 inverse errors worsen. Rejected maps remain diagnostic only. Complete study outcomes will be added after fitting. Investigate accumulated-update geometry controls, inverse representation/refinement error, and pyramid transition consistency without relaxing existing anatomical or geometry gates.
